name: stick-man
description: The main recurring hero of the toon-explainer videos. A stick figure man with a round pure white head (black outline) about the size of his torso, short spiky chestnut brown hair, black oval eyes with expressive eyebrows, a short neck, and a thin black stick body with stick arms and legs ending in small white gloved hands. Head size was reduced from the original oversized version on 2026-08-12 at Tony's direction.
prompt_desc: He has a round pure white head roughly the size of his torso with a black outline, short spiky chestnut brown hair, black oval eyes with expressive eyebrows, a short neck joining the head to the body, a thin black stick body, and thin black stick arms and legs with small white gloved hands

reference.note: v3 model sheet, adopted 2026-08-12. Two things changed from v1: the head came down to roughly torso size at Tony's direction, and a neck was added. v1 had an enormous head sitting directly on the torso with NO joint, and Redux copied that faithfully, so any pose other than standing straight rendered as a floating head with merged or extra hands and no front/behind layering. Validated on the four shots that actually failed in the videos (kneeling on a roof, lifting an AC unit into a window, charging a car in a garage, walking past a building): all four structurally clean. GOTCHA: asking for a smaller head WITHOUT explicitly banning ears, nose and skin tone gets you a normal cartoon human every time. Five of twelve candidates reverted that way. Keep 'blank white face, no ears, no nose, no skin tone' in any future model sheet prompt.
